append.detail: 2026-11-03: the six layouts (Stack, Card wall, Story, Calendar first, Shop front, Profile) are built for all sixteen Services trade kits: components/spotlight/services-kit-layouts.tsx and services-kit-layouts-css.ts (--sv-* tokens, six owner accents on Night and Day) and lib/spotlight/services-kit-content.ts (doors built as the design's record.js builds DOORS, from each kit's tools; prices, open times, reviews and the quote are sample-only, so a live page gets none). Registered in lib/spotlight/layouts.ts as `services-kit:*`, drawn by the Spotlight shell and given Services' faces on the public Spotlight page. Not yet: the Services Spotlight preset starting on Stack, which needs the owner's phrase for the 'none for others' pin in components/spotlight/network-kit-layouts.test.tsx; until then an owner picks a layout in the Spotlight editor.
